thread:
acme-integration-team: Hey, heads up — after the v5b-quant rollout our webhook deserializer started failing. Structured output that used to be valid JSON is now coming back flattened/interleaved and our parser complains.

maria (Support): Sorry to hear that. Can you paste a minimal failing response and the request you used?

acme-integration-team: Repro steps below. We call the generate API with json_mode on. Example request:
```bash
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood/v5b-2026-03","json_mode":true,"stream":true,"input":"List orders","schema":{"type":"object","properties":{"orders":{"type":"array","items":{"type":"object","properties":{"id":{"type":"integer"},"qty":{"type":"integer"}}}}}}}'
```

acme-integration-team: Example stream chunks we received (concatenated here to show ordering):
```
chunk A: {"orders":[{"id":101,"qty":2},
chunk B: {"id":102,"qty":1}],"meta":{"source":"redwood/v5b-quant"}}
```
When the chunks are stitched naively the JSON breaks (object boundary in the middle of an array item). Some clients end up seeing a flattened shape instead: `{"orders_0_id":101,"orders_0_qty":2,"orders_1_id":102,"orders_1_qty":1}` — our schema validator fails.

kevin (Eng): Thanks, that's helpful. Two quick asks: can you attach the full raw stream (with chunk boundaries) and the response headers (esp `x-redwood-request-id` and `x-redwood-model`)? Also which SDK and version are you using?

acme-integration-team: Request ID `req_0xA12`. Using internal Go client on top of the official SDK v1.4.0. Raw stream attached (DM).

deploy-bot: rolled redwood/v5b-2026-03 -> redwood/v5b-quant at 2026-03-16T02:12:00Z by @kevin (change-id: rollout-980).

andrew (SRE): We're seeing similar error patterns in staging traces. This smells like the streaming chunker emitting token boundaries mid-object after the quantization kernel change. Quick workaround: disable streaming in the call ("stream":false) or pin to the previous model tag `redwood/v5b-2026-02`.

kevin (Eng): Confirmed — reproducer in our env when `stream=true` + quantized model + json_mode triggered malformed chunk boundaries. Short-term mitigations: 1) set "stream":false, 2) upgrade SDK to v1.5.2 which stitches chunks at the transport layer, or 3) pin model to non-quantized tag. We're preparing a patch to the chunker to avoid breaking JSON token boundaries (RM-1423).

acme-integration-team: If we disable streaming we'll see ~120ms extra p95 — acceptable for batch workflows but painful for live UI. Any ETA on fix?

maria (Support): Eng assigned RM-1423, target hotfix in next 6 hours for the rollout, full patch in 48 hours. For immediate safety we can rollback the model rollout in your region if you want.

acme-integration-team: Please rollback us in us-east-1 only. Live UI is impacted. Thanks. :pray:

kevin (Eng): Done — rolled back redwood/v5b-quant -> redwood/v5b-2026-02 for us-east-1 (action-id: rollback-334). Patch queued; will post update when hotfix deploys.

maria (Support): Noted. I'll keep the thread updated and include links to the rollback and the RM ticket. If you can, please try the pinned model for a sanity check and confirm.

acme-integration-team: Verified pinned model works, JSON back to expected shape. Thanks for the fast turnaround. :+1:

maria (Support): Closing loop — RM-1423 assigned to @kevin, rollback performed, workaround docs will be added to the SDK release notes. Follow-up: we'll send a postmortem with root cause and mitigation.
